stock.description: TOM Group Limited functions as an investment holding company, engaging in diverse technology and media ventures across Hong Kong, Mainland China, Taiwan, and other Asian territories. Its extensive operations are structured into five core divisions: E-Commerce, Mobile Internet, Social Network, Publishing, and Advertising. The E-Commerce Group is dedicated to delivering mobile and internet-based marketplace services to consumers, alongside providing technical support for electronic commerce and retail activities. The Mobile Internet Group offers a range of mobile internet services, digital advertising solutions, and bespoke commercial enterprise tools. Through its Social Network Group, the company manages online communities and social networking platforms, which it monetizes through related digital advertising. The Publishing Group oversees the production and circulation of magazines and books, in addition to selling associated advertising and products. Finally, the Advertising Group specializes in outdoor media services, including media sales, event organization, marketing strategies, and the sale of advertising space on its outdoor assets. Beyond these primary segments, TOM Group maintains a portfolio of trademarks and domain names and operates a consumer-to-consumer marketplace accessible via mobile and online channels. Its service offerings also encompass internet content provision, online advertising, value-added telecommunications, management support, and email services. The company further owns and manages a dedicated website and an electronic marketplace for agricultural goods. Additional business involvements include the development of software, electronics, and computer network systems; the provision of online community and social networking platforms; the publishing, distribution, and retail of books and magazines; and active participation in event management and media procurement. Founded in 1999 as TOM.COM LIMITED, the company officially adopted the name TOM Group Limited in 2004, with its corporate headquarters situated in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
